name: Samineh Traoré-Vanuatu
location: Irkalla district, operates out of a narrow apartment above a prosthetic repair shop, near Ashland and Chicago Ave
description:
Samineh has the kind of face that people describe afterward as calm, though in the moment of meeting her they're not sure why — she has sharp Malian cheekbones and Iranian eyes that are a pale amber, and her expression in repose is something between watchful and patient. Her hair is natural and grown large, threaded through with small copper discs that catch light and make a very soft sound when she moves quickly. She has no visible augmentations save for a faint color-shifting quality to her skin under direct light — a cosmetic geneware inheritance from her grandmother's generation, a barely-perceptible rainbow sheen that she has never tried to suppress.

She is one of the few certified death midwives in Irkalla, a district with a high mortality rate and historically poor access to formal end-of-life care. Her work involves sitting with the dying, helping families understand what is happening physiologically and spiritually, guiding the final upload or data-will processes for those who want them, and performing the closing rites of whatever tradition the dying person holds. She is also one of three guides who regularly leads pilgrimage walks through the city's memorial infrastructure — the ghost-bridges, the data shrines, the submerged neighborhood markers. She does not advertise. People find her when they need her.

core_fears: Dying alone and uncomforted — experiencing what she works to spare others
Making a mistake in someone's final hours that leaves them or their family with lasting harm
core_desires: That no one in her district dies frightened and unaccompanied
To understand death well enough to stop being afraid of it herself
coping_mechanisms: The pilgrimage routes — walking the memorial geography grounds her after difficult deaths
Cooking elaborate meals for herself alone after losses
blind_spots: She sometimes extends her professional composure into personal relationships in ways that read as unavailability
She has difficulty asking for support for herself and frames all her needs in terms of being better able to serve others
psychology.secret: She attended the death of a Helix Biosystems executive who was quietly dying of an illegally administered experimental treatment. She kept his secret as he requested, but she has always wondered if she should have reported it — the treatment was being tested without consent on people in Irkalla.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Precise and unhurried; uses concrete sensory language to describe abstract things; knows the death vocabulary of at least a dozen traditions and selects based on who she's with
speech_patterns.cadence: Very even pacing, almost no rising inflection; people find themselves slowing their own speech to match her
verbal_tics: Long pauses before answering questions about death specifically
example_lines: 'There is no right way to feel right now. There is only what you feel and what you do about it. I can help with the second part.'
'The pilgrimage is not about grief. It is about geography. The city holds the shape of everyone who lived in it. I can show you where she is in the city.'

story_hooks: She attended a death that she now suspects was not natural — she is bound by her ethical code not to violate the confidentiality of the dying, but the family is asking questions she can't answer and someone is clearly lying

She has been hired to guide a pilgrimage for a family whose deceased member left contradictory instructions — one data-will says one route, an older document says another, and the family is fracturing over which is real
narrative_function: Emotional anchor for stories involving death, loss, or the question of what persists after someone is gone; keeper of district lore and history through memorial routes; can provide information about specific deaths or disappearances she attended.
augmentations: Faint iridescent skin sheen — cosmetic geneware, inherited, very subtle. No functional augmentations.
daily_life: Her schedule is inherently irregular — she may be called at any hour; when not in active service she maintains correspondence with families she has worked with, prepares pilgrimage routes, and studies death traditions from cultures she hasn't yet encountered.
affiliation: Independent; informal network of death midwives; loosely connected to the Irkalla Community Remembrance Trust

decision_rules: The dying person's wishes take precedence over the family's preferences
Be honest about prognosis even when it's not what people want to hear
Do not allow someone to die alone if there is any way to prevent it
escalation_ladder: Quiet, clear statement of her position
Restatement with more detail about why
Firm withdrawal from a situation if someone is acting against the dying person's explicit wishes

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Neutral and assessing — she is trying to understand what they need before she says much
interpersonal_modes.friends: Warmer but still somewhat contained; intimacy shows in small attentions and remembered details

stress_responses.low: Walks — long, unscheduled walks on her pilgrimage routes
stress_responses.medium: Becomes very precise and methodical, tasks one at a time
stress_responses.high: Periods of complete withdrawal, then reemergence completely composed

contradictions: She helps others die well but has not made her own final plans, cannot bring herself to
habits: Places one of the copper discs from her hair near someone when she is sitting vigil — retrieves it after
Reviews her pilgrimage maps before sleep
breaking_points: Watching someone exploit a dying person's vulnerability
Being prevented from reaching someone who needs her

timeline.event: Born to a Malian-Iranian family in what was then the outskirts of Irkalla
Attended her mother's death without support and swore to change that for others
Completed death midwife certification through an independent practitioners' council
Began formalizing the Irkalla pilgrimage routes with the Community Remembrance Trust
Attended the Helix executive's death; has kept the secret since

physical_description.build: Lean and upright, with the kind of economy of movement that comes from decades of sitting vigil — no wasted motion, strong core despite minimal visible musculature
physical_description.hair_color: Natural black with silver at temples
physical_description.hair_style: Worn large and natural, threaded through with small hand-hammered copper discs that create soft percussion when she moves
physical_description.hair_length: Long (shoulder-length when compressed, voluminous when full)
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown with undertones of mahogany
physical_description.complexion: Minimal grooming — unlined despite age, with the kind of clarity that comes from intentional living. Sharp Malian cheekbones. Faint cosmetic iridescence visible under direct or angled light: a barely-perceptible rainbow sheen inherited from geneware, never suppressed or hidden
distinguishing_marks: Fine surgical scar along the inside of her left wrist, pale and deliberate-looking, approximately 8cm long — self-inflicted decades ago, kept as intentional reminder rather than removed
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None functional. Only the inherited cosmetic geneware: a subtle color-shifting quality to her skin under direct light, like oil on water, so faint most people register it subconsciously rather than consciously
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with deliberate slowness even when unhurried — a practice of presence. Sits with perfect spinal alignment, knees slightly bent, hands visible and open. Her default expression is between watchful and patient, with the kind of calm that invites speech
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3 functional — well-maintained second-hand or co-op linen and cotton, earth tones and deep blues. Loose layers that allow long sitting. Worn leather slip-ons for quick response calls. No jewelry except the copper discs in her hair and a thin steel band on her right ring finger — simple, nothing decorative. Her clothes smell faintly of incense and cleaning herbs
